Markets.title: US stocks today: Nasdaq leads Wall Street higher as SpaceX, Super Micro lift AI sentiment
Markets.summary: US stocks finished higher on Wednesday, led by the Nasdaq due to positive AI sentiment from SpaceX and Super Micro Computer. Gains were partially limited by weakness in communication shares like Netflix and AT&T as investors awaited major tech earnings.

Markets.title: Meta raises AI spending forecast to $145 billion, plans new share issue; Q3 revenue beats estimates
Markets.summary: Meta increased its 2026 capital expenditure forecast to between $135 billion and $145 billion to accelerate AI expansion while also announcing plans for non-voting shares. The company reported stronger-than-expected third-quarter revenue despite facing mounting legal challenges and intensifying competition.

Markets.title: BlackRock expands AI push with new robotics ETF as investor enthusiasm cools
Markets.summary: BlackRock has launched a new robotics exchange-traded fund to target companies using intelligent machines in industries like manufacturing and transportation. This move expands the firm's artificial intelligence offerings as investor enthusiasm for the broader AI sector becomes more selective.

Markets.title: US Treasury yields slip as AI concerns boost safe haven demand ahead of 20 year auction
Markets.summary: US Treasury yields dropped as investors worried about borrowing costs impacting AI stocks ahead of a $13 billion 20-year auction. Meanwhile, markets continued to anticipate little chance of a Federal Reserve rate hike.

Markets.title: Persistent Systems launches Rs 4,265-cr QIP; floor price set at Rs 5,550/share
Markets.summary: Persistent Systems has launched a qualified institutional placement to raise up to $450 million, or approximately Rs 4,265 crore. The IT company has set the floor price at Rs 5,550 per share, with a potential discount of up to 5% for investors.

Markets.title: Stocks, gold or crypto? The last 3 years’ returns have a surprising answer
Markets.summary: Over a three-year period, Bitcoin outperformed stocks, gold, and silver with nearly 234% returns. However, precious metals performed better over a single year as cryptocurrency values declined.

Geo-Political.title: Missiles hit Kyiv after Russia agrees to US call to resume Ukraine peace talks
Geo-Political.summary: Missiles struck Kyiv shortly after Moscow agreed in principle to US calls to resume peace talks with Ukraine. US President Donald Trump stated that these developments bring the world the closest it has been to ending the war.

Geo-Political.title: Rosenberg: US diplomatic push offers little hope for imminent Ukraine peace
Geo-Political.summary: US diplomatic efforts to achieve peace in Ukraine currently offer little hope for a quick resolution. BBC Russia Editor Steve Rosenberg reports that Russian President Vladimir Putin does not feel pressured to end the war at this time.

Geo-Political.title: Macron accuses foreign leaders of exploiting French riots
Geo-Political.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron accused foreign leaders of exploiting recent riots in France for political gain. This remark appears to target Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and former US President Donald Trump ahead of their upcoming elections.

Geo-Political.title: Pope does not need further treatment after lung cancer surgery
Geo-Political.summary: Test results confirmed that the Pope's lung cancer was localized. He does not require any further medical treatment following his surgery.

Geo-Political.title: 'Targeted' attack on much-loved MP leaves Australian town heartbroken
Geo-Political.summary: An Australian member of parliament, described by locals as a kind and dedicated community advocate, has survived a targeted attack resulting in the amputation of both legs. The violent incident has left the residents of the MP's town deeply heartbroken.

Geo-Political.title: Family of prison officer killed by IRA receives state apology
Geo-Political.summary: The family of Brian Stack, an Irish prison officer shot by the IRA in Dublin in 1983, has received a formal state apology. Stack died from his injuries 18 months after the attack.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An author discovered their SaaS WordPress course was recommended as the top result when asking ChatGPT for the best course on the subject. The author achieved this free traffic without using paid advertising.

Data & Insights.title: RBI MPC Minutes: Governor Sanjay Malhotra ties future hikes to growth-inflation outlook — here is what he said
Data & Insights.summary: RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra stated that future interest rate hikes will depend on the evolving growth and inflation outlook. Policymakers hold differing views on how to contain inflation without unnecessarily restricting economic activity.

Data & Insights.title: RBI MPC minutes reveal 2 members opposed shift from neutral stance to calibrated tightening in October meeting
Data & Insights.summary: Two members of the RBI's monetary policy committee opposed shifting the policy stance from neutral to calibrated tightening during the October meeting. However, all six members unanimously supported raising the repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.50%.

Data & Insights.title: Core sector growth accelerates to 7.9% in September, fastest in new series
Data & Insights.summary: India's core sector growth accelerated to 7.9% in September, driven largely by significant increases in iron ore, electricity, and coal production. Conversely, fertilizers, natural gas, and crude oil experienced production contractions during the same month.

Data & Insights.title: India's infrastructure output grows 7.9% year-on-year in September on strong coal, steel output
Data & Insights.summary: India's infrastructure output grew by 7.9% year-on-year in September, accelerating from the 3.1% growth recorded in the same month last year. This increase was primarily driven by higher production of coal, refinery products, steel, and iron ore.

Data & Insights.title: IMF urges currency flexibility as RBI steps up rupee defence amid oil price pressures, foreign outflows
Data & Insights.summary: The International Monetary Fund advises countries to allow their currencies to adjust to global shocks rather than relying on limited foreign-exchange interventions. This guidance comes as the Reserve Bank of India defends the rupee against pressures from oil prices and foreign capital outflows.

Data & Insights.title: Govt to overhaul tax refund schemes for exporters, sets up two panels
Data & Insights.summary: The government is overhauling tax refund schemes for exporters and has established two panels to manage the process. This decision follows a late-month expenditure finance committee recommendation to improve fund targeting and utilization.

India.title: Delhi Content Creator Racially Abuses Tripura Youth, Minister Vows Strict Action
India.summary: A viral video showed content creator Amir Shokeen allegedly making racially derogatory remarks against a youth from Tripura. Minister Kiren Rijiju condemned the incident and vowed to take strict action against the perpetrator.

India.title: Protest Photos By Priyanka Gandhi's Son Taken Down At Delhi's Bikaner House. Officials Flagged 'Timing', He Tells NDTV
India.summary: Officials at Delhi's Bikaner House removed an art exhibition of youth protest photographs by Raihan Vadra, Priyanka Gandhi's son. Vadra stated that officials flagged the timing of the display, deeming the content objectionable.

India.title: Child Assault Convict, Nepali Citizen Escape From Chennai's Central Prison
India.summary: Sudeep Bogati, a 21-year-old Nepali citizen and child assault convict, escaped from Chennai's Central Prison. He had been held in the foreign nationals' block following his August 16 arrest for a theft case.

India.title: 'No More Jantar Mantar Protest Calls': Vow By CJP's Saurav Das, Ashutosh Ranka In Court
India.summary: Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka were released from judicial custody after promising the court they would no longer call for protests at Jantar Mantar. The activists had been jailed since October 14 for scaling the locked gates of Jantar Mantar to wave the national flag against its denotification as a protest site.

India.title: Air Quality Commission Meets Delhi Government Agencies Over Dust Pollution
India.summary: The Air Quality Commission met with Delhi government agencies to address dust pollution. The Commission emphasized that all agencies must strictly comply with and implement its statutory directions.

India.title: Nestle, Zydus Wellness Get Notices Over Claims About Infant Nutrition Products, Complan
India.summary: The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India has issued notices to Nestle and Zydus Wellness regarding claims made about their infant nutrition products and Complan. Specifically, regulators have demanded evidence to support Complan's advertising claim that it promotes "2 times faster growth."

General.title: Burnham defends Jackdaw decision as Badenoch urges PM to overturn ban on new oil and gas licences
General.summary: Andy Burnham supports the decision to proceed with the Jackdaw gas field, which could start producing gas by the end of this month. Meanwhile, Kemi Badenoch is urging the Prime Minister to overturn the ban on new oil and gas licences.

General.title: 'Targeted' attack on much-loved MP leaves Australian town heartbroken
General.summary: A much-loved Australian MP and community advocate was the victim of a targeted attack that required both legs to be amputated. The local town has been left heartbroken by the violent incident.

General.title: Aberfan disaster 'most tragic of days imaginable' says King on 60th anniversary
General.summary: King Charles marked the 60th anniversary of the Aberfan disaster, calling it the most tragic of days imaginable. The 1966 colliery spoil tip collapse killed 116 children and 28 adults.
